test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph**:

P. After laying out a grid across the site, the team started to dig out the topsoil layers gently.

Q. They meticulously documented the location of artefacts as they were gradually unearthed using trowels and brushes.

R. Every item they discovered, including old tools and shattered ceramics, was cleaned and catalogued.

S. The artefacts brought the past of a long-lost culture to life by telling a story.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. P, Q, R, S .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph begins with sentence P, as it introduces the initial action of laying out the grid and starting the excavation.
 
• Sentence Q logically follows, describing how the team meticulously documented the artefacts as they were unearthed.
 
• Sentence R comes next, explaining what the team did with the items discovered during the excavation.
 
• Finally, sentence S concludes the paragraph by highlighting the significance of the artefacts in telling the story of a long-lost culture.

Correct arrangement: *P, Q, R, S*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When arranging sentence parts, focus on logical progression and coherence.
 
• Identify introductory sentences, supporting details, and concluding remarks to create a meaningful paragraph.
 
• This question tests comprehension, sequence-building skills, and grammatical correctness.
